description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source testing management tool. It handles generating and displaying test execution reports based on user input, initializing GUI components, and managing report parameters. It references other configuration and utility PHP files, initializes report-specific GUI settings, and interacts with database managers related to test plans and projects.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI context for report display, setting test plan and project info, platforms, filters, and localization labels.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Collects and initializes input parameters for report generation, processing $_REQUEST and session variables.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Constructs the email configuration object used for report notifications, including the mail subject.

methods.name: helper2ISO
methods.description: Converts localized date inputs into ISO format for database compatibility.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has necessary rights ('testplan_metrics') to access this report functionality.
